payment_and_billing.gateway: PayU India — PayU-hosted checkout (secure.payu.in). CareerLoop never receives, sees, or stores card numbers, UPI PINs, or bank credentials.
payment_and_billing.accepted_methods: whatever PayU hosts on its checkout: UPI, debit/credit cards, net banking, wallets
flow_implemented: user completes signup details (name, email, phone; email verified by 6-digit OTP) and picks a plan
server creates a payment order with a unique transaction reference (txnid) and signs the checkout with SHA-512
browser is redirected to PayU's hosted page and pays there
PayU posts the result back to CareerLoop; the server verifies the cryptographic response hash, matches the amount, and calls PayU's verify_payment API as a second check
only after that verification is the payment marked completed and the account created
payment_and_billing.account_creation_rule: No CareerLoop account exists until a payment is verified. If payment fails, nothing is created and no credentials are stored.

steps_in_order: Step 0: name, email, 10-digit Indian mobile, password, domain, experience, city; duplicate email/phone blocked here; a 6-digit email OTP is sent and must be verified to continue
Step 1: webcam photo (live capture, single frame, not a video recording) with client-side face detection; photo is stored
Step 2: resume PDF upload (optional in the form, but the paid-flow UI encourages it), program/plan selection, DPDP consent checkbox
Step 3: payment on PayU's hosted page
Conclusion: PayU returns the user to a success page; the account is created server-side after verified payment
signup_flow.uniqueness_rules: one account per email address and one account per 10-digit mobile number, enforced by database unique indexes
signup_flow.password_handling: passwords are stored only as hashes by Supabase Auth; the plaintext exists transiently in the pending payment record until the payment callback consumes it, then it is wiped

otp_mechanics.storage: only a peppered SHA-256 hash of the code is stored; the code itself is never persisted
otp_mechanics.consumption: a verified code creates exactly one account

I understand that the program fee covers weekly mock tests, live mentorship, and resume curation, with complimentary direct referrals to fast-hiring HR partner networks.
